fields.summary: Smoke test: As a Game Developer I want to create a Feature Schema column of type enumeration
fields.description:
> **Latest run: 21 Sep 2026 — 🟢 feature** `live` · 🔴 conformance `failed` (12 pass / 1 fail / 0 blocked).  
> Defect raised: KING-22977.  
> Full report in the comments. **This description is the plan; every run is a comment.**

Smoke test plan for KING-22218. Produced by the `smoke-plan` skill; executed by `smoke-run`. This sub-task is the source of truth — the plan, the run report and any findings all live here.

## Scope

Covers **AC 1, AC 2 and AC 5** — the dashboard path that is actually in `In Testing`.

## Preconditions

* Run on the **test** environment (`develop`). `enumeration_id` is unreleased — present on `develop` only, absent from `release-candidate` and `master` — so preprod and prod cannot carry a binding at all. `[KING-22318, 14 Aug]`
* Operator login with rights to create a Feature Schema, Feature Settings and a Feature Configuration in the game.
* A game no other team is editing. Editing an enumeration's values can delete an enumeration a player field or event parameter also binds — see Open question 6.
* **Use a personal sandbox project, never** `Autotest Project 1…21` — creating entities in the CI pool silently shifts other entities' priorities. The 21 Sep run used TestMykyta.

## Steps

**1.** `[GATE]` Open the game → **Feature Schema** → create a new schema, click **+ Add Item**, open the item's type dropdown.
_Expected:_ `enumeration` is offered as a column type, alongside the existing five (Integer, Decimal, String, Boolean, BundleKey). `[AC-1]`

**2.** `[GATE]` Select type `enumeration` and give the column a title.
_Expected:_ A control appears for that column through which its option list can be supplied. `[Story]`

**2a.** Inspect that control.
_Expected:_ It offers a manual value-entry mode and a file-import mode. `[KING-22320]`
✅ **Open question 2 is ANSWERED** by the 21 Sep run: there is **no** control for binding to an existing enumeration by ID. Both modes create a new enumeration, so AC-1 as literally worded is not met by the UI. This step is no longer `blocked`.

**3.** `[GATE]` Supply a short option list (`bronze`, `silver`, `gold`) and save, then publish the schema.
_Expected:_ The schema saves without error and the column persists with type `enumeration`. `[AC-1]`
_Run note:_ values are entered **comma-separated on one line**.

**4.** Re-open the saved schema.
_Expected:_ The column still shows type `enumeration` and its binding is retained. `[AC-1]`

**5.** Save the schema again **without changing** the option list.
_Expected:_ The save succeeds and the column's `enumerationId` is **unchanged** from step 3 — no new enumeration is minted and the existing one is not deleted. Read the id from the schema API response; the values are write-only and never returned. `[KING-22317, 4 Sep — flagged there as the highest-value check: an early build replaced and deleted the live enumeration on every ordinary save]`

**6.** `[GATE]` Create Feature Settings and a Feature Configuration on this schema, add a row, set the enumeration column to `gold`, and save.
_Expected:_ The configuration saves successfully. `[AC-2]`

**7.** `[GATE]` Change that cell to `platinum` (not in the list) and save.
_Expected:_ The save is rejected with a message naming the column and the offending value, returned as **422** — not 500. `[AC-2]` `[KING-22318]`
_Run note:_ the UI picker blocks off-list entry up front ("No results found"), so this must be sent via the API to reach the backend validator the AC is about.

**8.** Change the cell to `Gold` (a case variant of a valid option) and save.
_Expected:_ Rejected. Matching is exact and byte-for-byte — no trimming, no case folding. `[AC-2]` `[KING-22318, 14 Aug]`

**9.** Export the configuration to CSV, edit the enumeration cell to an off-list value, then run **Import** and its pre-import preview.
_Expected:_ Preview and import both reject the same value. The CSV path reports the **first** problem only, with a line number. `[AC-2]` `[KING-22318]`
_Run note:_ there is no separate `/import` POST route (405); rows persist through the same `PATCH /data` validator, so preview and save agree by construction.

**10.** Add a second `enumeration` column and supply a large option list (≈1000 values) via file import. Save the schema.
_Expected:_ The schema saves and the column is usable. `[AC-5]`
_Run note:_ use a **new schema** — editing a published version returns `409 Schema version could not be changed because it has configurations` (correct pre-existing behaviour). The import file must be **comma-separated on one line**.

**11.** In the configuration, open that column's value picker and type a search term.
_Expected:_ The list is searchable and renders at most **20** results rather than all values. `[KING-22320]`

**12.** Attempt to supply more than 1000 values.
_Expected:_ Rejected with the error `Maximum 1000 values allowed`. `[KING-22320]`
⚠️ **Known defect KING-22977** — the limit is enforced but no error is shown.

## Grounding

13 steps. **8** expected results come from the acceptance criteria, **1** from the Story body, **4** from dev implementation comments on KING-22317 / KING-22318 / KING-22320. **0** from design and **0** from a PRD.

## Open questions

Duplicated as a comment on the parent Story, where the owner will see them.

1. **The Story contradicts what shipped.** Out of scope excludes _"Creating or editing the enumerations and their options"_, and AC 1 binds the column to one **existing** enumeration by ID. Should AC 1 and Out of scope be updated, or should on-the-fly creation be removed? — _the 21 Sep run confirms the UI only creates; it never binds an existing enumeration_
2. ✅ **ANSWERED 21 Sep.** The UI has **no** bind-by-existing-enumeration-ID control. Only _Enter manually_ and _Import from file_ exist, and both create a new enumeration. AC 1 is therefore unmet as literally worded even though the feature works.
3. **AC 3 (SDK) has no sub-task.** Is it delivered, delivered elsewhere, or still to do?
4. **AC 4 (integration skill) has no sub-task**, and the linked bug KING-21757 — which is exactly this behaviour — is still `To Do`. Is AC 4 in scope for this Story? It currently looks unmet.
5. **Per-value length limit:** KING-22320 mentions one with its own error but gives neither the limit nor the copy. Not exercised by the 21 Sep run — with no stated limit there is no expected result to test against.
6. **Already raised on KING-22317, repeated because it is a Story-level product call:** editing a column's option list deletes the old enumeration if no other _schema table field_ references it — but player fields and event parameters bind the same enumerations invisibly, so a genuine edit can delete something another service depends on. The alternative is leaking one enumeration per edit.

**None of these block the run.** All withhold a _verdict_ on specific steps; the plan is runnable as written, and was run in full on 21 Sep.

## FE requests

The `EnumerationConfig` component is new. Still missing a stable hook: the value-list rows themselves, the "N items" counter, and the `Import Enumeration List` confirmation dialog.

## Testability verdict

**Runnable, but the acceptance criteria have drifted from what was built.** 12 of 13 steps trace to a written source and 5 gate steps establish whether the feature is live.

fields.description:
Mocks – <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-0">https://www.figma.com/design/rWkhhmGtoKzfZje8qvYY1C/Kinoa_Cloud?node-id=7759-200816&t=d1eynlf4mN0HlzI8-11</custom>  (added by Verba Aug 14, 2026)  
  
As a Game Developer, I want a Feature Schema column of type `enumeration`, so that the column only accepts one value from a fixed, managed list.

## Motivation

Enumerations are managed in the meta service (see "Add enumerations to system"), but `enumeration` is not a supported Feature Schema column type: the operator UI offers only 5 types (Integer, Decimal, String, Boolean, BundleKey), and the SDK and the integration skill cannot use it.

## Acceptance criteria

* A Game Developer can select `enumeration` as a column type when creating a Feature Schema in the UI. The column is bound to one existing enumeration by its enumeration ID.
* When a Feature Configuration is created or edited, an enumeration column value is validated: only a value that belongs to the referenced enumeration is accepted; any other value is rejected with a clear message.
* The SDK supports the `enumeration` column type: it reads, saves and returns enumeration column values.
* The integration skill (create-schema) supports the `enumeration` column type instead of replacing it with another type.
* Enumerations with a large number of values are supported (selecting and validating a value stays correct and usable).

## Out of scope

* Creating or editing the enumerations and their options.

## Brief

Make `enumeration` a fully supported Feature Schema column type. A game developer picks `enumeration` in the UI and binds it to an enumeration from the meta service; the SDK and the integration skill support the type; and the value is validated when a Feature Configuration is created or edited.
